description: Change a figure Lone Pair made earlier and get the new figure. `ops` changes atoms and bonds: add, change element or charge, delete, bond, move, recolour. Atoms are named by their id in `drawing` (or {map: n} for an atom-map number from SMILES such as [CH3:1]). The operations are applied all or nothing: if one fails or leaves an atom over its valence, nothing changes and the error names the operation. The result's `changes` lists what was added, changed and removed, with the formula before and after. Also: add a structure beside it, change the journal style, or put a caption under it. Give the earlier result's `drawing`. Everything else in the drawing stays as it was. Not for drawing something new (use draw). The result carries `drawing` (Lone Pair JSON to pass to edit_drawing or back in as `input`) and `notes` (anything changed on reading or lost in the format).

add.description: A structure to add to the right of the drawing (SMILES, InChI, molfile).

add_is_name.description: True when `add` is a compound name to look up at PubChem. Default false.

caption.description: Text to put under the drawing.

color.description: black (default); cpk to colour heteroatoms (N blue, O red, S yellow, halogens green); or one colour as #rrggbb for every line and label, such as #ffffff over a dark picture.

dpi.description: PNG resolution, 300 by default; 600 for print.

drawing.description: The `drawing` object from an earlier result.

embed.description: For a structure that goes into a larger figure (an SVG or HTML figure you build, or a picture an image model made): format svg or png only. The SVG gets its own id, data-smiles, data-formula and data-inchikey, and px sizes; the result's `embed` gives its box, the drawn bond length and each atom's position (atom n = the n-th atom of the input), and how to place it. Place it whole and scale it uniformly; never redraw or retouch it. Default false.

embed_id.description: With embed: the id for this structure in your figure (letters, digits, - and _). Give one when the same structure appears twice. Default: lp- and the start of its InChIKey.

format.description: png (default; returned as an image), svg (returned as text), pdf or eps (returned as base64 in `data_base64`).

highlight.description: Highlight parts of the structure with a coloured band under them, e.g. the atoms that react: [{ "atoms": [1, 2, 3], "color": "#ffe066" }]. Atoms are numbered from 1 in input order; bonds between listed atoms are highlighted too, and `bonds` adds others. SVG and PNG only.

bonds.description: Bonds as pairs of atom numbers.

opaque.description: White background instead of transparent (SVG, PNG). Default false.

ops.description: Operations, in order. add_atom {el, bond_to, order}; set_atom {atom, el, charge, lp, iso, map}; delete {atoms, bonds}; add_bond {a, b, order, stereo}; set_bond {bond or a+b, order, stereo, kind}; move {atoms, dx, dy}; add_group {smiles, at} (a substituent, its first atom joining: "[N+](=O)[O-]"); add_structure {smiles, at: right|below}; add_text {text}; add_arrow {type, from {x,y}, to {x,y}, arrow_size, bold, favor}, type also dipole or arc; set_color {atoms, bonds, color #rrggbb}. Examples: lonepair.app/agents#edit

outline_text.description: SVG: draw atom labels and text as outlines instead of text, so the figure looks the same in any program, with or without the fonts. Default false.

style.description: Journal style. acs = ACS Document 1996 (default), rsc = RSC, nature = Nature Reviews, slides = heavier lines for slides.

name: edit_drawing
title: Change an earlier figure
